current_games.title: Overwatch 2
current_games.why: Same team-based hero brawling as Marvel Rivals, with a huge cast of roles to master.

current_games.title: Paladins
current_games.why: Free-to-play hero shooter with a card-based loadout twist, great if Marvel Rivals hooked you.

current_games.title: Deadlock
current_games.why: Valve's hero shooter-MOBA hybrid scratches the same team-composition itch as Marvel Rivals.

current_games.title: Gigantic: Rampage Edition
current_games.why: Stylish 5v5 hero shooter with guardians to defend, a lesser-known pick for Rivals fans.

current_games.title: Apex Legends
current_games.why: Slick movement and squad play if Fortnite's battle royale is your comfort zone.

current_games.title: The Finals
current_games.why: Destructible arenas and squad chaos, a fresh spin on the Fortnite-style shooter.

current_games.title: Hunt: Showdown 1896
current_games.why: Tense squad-based extraction shooter for when you want stakes bigger than a Battlefront match.

current_games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide
current_games.why: Since Halo Infinite's punchy arena gunplay landed, this delivers the same weighty, sci-fi FPS combat with a co-op squad focus that echoes the team energy of Marvel Rivals and Battlefront.

current_games.title: Wreckfest
current_games.why: Loved Forza Horizon 5's playful car handling? Wreckfest keeps that arcade drivability but adds destructible demolition-derby chaos for a rowdier take on the Forza feel.

current_games.title: The Crew Motorfest
current_games.why: Hawaiian open-world racing playlists in the same laid-back spirit as Forza Horizon.

current_games.title: Need for Speed Unbound
current_games.why: Street-race arcade thrills for Forza fans who want more attitude and night runs.

current_games.title: Art of Rally
current_games.why: A stylised top-down rally game, a great indie palate cleanser between Forza sessions.

current_games.title: Riders Republic
current_games.why: Massive multiplayer bike, ski and wingsuit playground for Descenders riders.

current_games.title: OlliOlli World
current_games.why: A natural broadening pick after Lonely Mountains and Descenders — same trick-chaining, run-perfecting flow but in a stylish 2D skating world.

current_games.title: Skate 3
current_games.why: Cult skateboarding sandbox for anyone who loves nailing lines like in Descenders.

current_games.title: Session: Skate Sim
current_games.why: Deep, physics-driven skateboarding for players who obsess over trick craft.

current_games.title: eFootball 2024
current_games.why: The Pro Evo lineage offers a free alternative for EA Sports FC and FIFA fans.

current_games.title: NBA 2K25
current_games.why: If FC and FIFA are your MyCareer of choice, 2K brings the same depth to basketball.

current_games.title: Football Manager 2024
current_games.why: For when you want to run the club instead of just playing matches in EA Sports FC.

current_games.title: UFL
current_games.why: A free-to-play football challenger to FIFA and FC, worth a kick for football fans.

current_games.title: Sleeping Dogs: Definitive Edition
current_games.why: Captures the same open-city traversal and flashy melee/gunplay rhythm that made Spider-Man 2 click, with a cinematic Hong Kong crime story on top.

current_games.title: Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order
current_games.why: If Survivor was a hit, its predecessor delivers the same lightsaber-and-Force combat, Metroidvania planets and cinematic Star Wars beats you already love.

current_games.title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
current_games.why: Plague Tale's slow stealth didn't stick, so swap to a punchier, blockbuster take on cinematic adventure — big set-pieces, gunfights and climbing that pair well with Spider-Man and 007 First Light.

current_games.title: Hi-Fi Rush
current_games.why: Colourful rhythm-action romp with the playful energy of Super Mario Odyssey.
